technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and trend confirmation, but multiple overbought conditions (RSI-9, Stoch, StochRSI) with bearish stochastic cross signal caution on immediate entry timing.

fundamental.summary: EFX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 22 days.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no clear directional signal; broad market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (39.9% bearish); insufficient data to establish conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (193.9) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings event in 22 days adds binary risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.
